body:
Answer: SK Immigration’s complete Saudi work visa processing package is PKR 15,000 and covers coordination for E-Number / biometrics + Protector + visa processing support for eligible employment cases. Medical checks, government fees and other authority charges are separate and listed before you pay. This is not an E-Number-only product and not a visa outcome guarantee.

Primary page for this topic: saudi visa processing pakistan — this answer supports that guide. Prefer the primary page for requirements, fees and FAQ.

Package scope

Included in PKR 15,000Usually separate
File triage and checklist for Saudi employment processingMedical / insurance as required
E-Number / biometrics readiness and coordination supportGovernment / embassy / system fees
Protector pathway guidance where applicableTravel tickets
Visa processing support within agreed scopeAttestation stamps if your papers need a new chain

Who this package is for

  • Pakistani workers with a credible Saudi employment path
  • Clients who want end-to-end processing help — not a single screenshot service
  • Cases that can follow OEP / protector rules when the law requires them

Who should skip it

  • Anyone offered a “guaranteed Saudi visa” with no employer paperwork
  • Pure visit/tourism applicants
  • Clients asking for fake experience or fake medicals — we refuse

Start here

Full Saudi processing page · OEP partner licence · WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 · Free consult to confirm fit before payment.

Why we emphasise “complete processing”

Many ads sell “E-Number only” cheaply, then surprise clients with protector and visa steps. Our PKR 15,000 package is scoped to walk eligible employment cases through the coordination steps clients actually need — with a written split between SK service fee and authority fees.

Typical client journey

  1. WhatsApp / office triage — passport validity, prior Gulf history, contract papers
  2. Quote sheet — PKR 15,000 scope + estimated third-party costs
  3. Biometrics / E-Number scheduling support
  4. Protector pathway when overseas employment rules require it
  5. Visa processing support to stamping / issuance as applicable
  6. Travel readiness notes (still subject to authority timelines)

Documents commonly requested

  • Passport with required blank pages / validity
  • Photos to Saudi specifications for your case
  • Employment contract / visa authorisation papers from the Saudi side
  • CNIC and any prior iqama/visa history details
  • Medicals only through approved channels when instructed

Compliance note

Where Pakistani overseas employment law requires licensed OEP involvement, we align with partner licence processes (see OEP licence note). Skipping protector because a broker is impatient is how people get stranded.

Book a fit-check

Free consult before payment: WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 · full processing page · pricing.

How payment works

Pay the SK service fee only after you understand the written scope. Authority fees should be paid through the correct official or medical channels — not as unmarked cash to random collectors. Keep every receipt.

If your case is not eligible for complete processing (missing employer side, wrong visa type), we stop at free consult rather than forcing the PKR 15,000 package.
